statement: A California stock corporation, and a foreign corporation qualified in California, must file a Statement of Information (Form SI-550) with the Secretary of State within 90 days of its initial registration and every year thereafter, with a $25 filing-plus-disclosure fee; failure to file can bring Franchise Tax Board-assessed penalties and suspension or forfeiture, and effective August 1, 2026 online filing requires established web User Access.
caveat: LLCs file Form LLC-12 every two years instead, fees and filing windows change, and the statutory basis (Corporations Code § 1502) should be checked directly — leginfo.legislature.ca.gov was unreachable to non-browser clients at review time, so this card rests on the agency form and guidance. This repo does not file the statement or compute penalties.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (state-coverage wave 2026-10-03); independent domain expert review pending
